title: PHILIPS TAH6550 Bluetooth Wireless Over-Ear Headphones with 3 Mics, 60 Hours Battery Life, 40mm Drivers, Bluetooth 5.3, Dual Pairing, USB-C Charging, AUX Connectivity, Black
bullets: ULTRA-LONG 60 HOURS PLAYTIME – Enjoy extended listening with up to 60 hours of battery life on a single charge. Perfect for travel, work, online classes, gaming, and daily entertainment without frequent recharging.

POWERFUL 40MM DYNAMIC DRIVERS – Experience immersive sound with deep bass, detailed mids, and clear highs. The 20Hz–20kHz frequency response delivers an enjoyable audio experience for music, movies, podcasts, and calls.

ENHANCED CALL CLARITY WITH 3 MICROPHONES – Equipped with 3 built-in microphones for clearer voice pickup during calls, virtual meetings, and video conferences, making these headphones ideal for both work and personal use.

BLUETOOTH 5.3 & DUAL DEVICE PAIRING – Stay connected with advanced Bluetooth 5.3 technology offering stable wireless performance up to 10 meters. Dual pairing support lets you seamlessly switch between your smartphone, laptop, tablet, or other Bluetooth-enabled devices.

WIRELESS FREEDOM WITH AUX BACKUP – Enjoy the flexibility of Bluetooth wireless listening or switch to wired mode using the included AUX cable. Features intuitive button controls, USB-C fast charging, and a comfortable over-ear design for all-day use.
